host.ask: Host name or IP of the PC running Vision64's control server (usually this PC)
host.help: Vision64's TCP/IP Runtime Control Server option; its port and command set come from Bruker's documentation for the option. Every shipped command string is a placeholder.

data_dir.ask: Folder the recipe auto-saves .OPDx datasets to
data_dir.help: The recipe's Advanced Options > Auto Save File Name folder; the package sets the file name <sample_id>_<token>.OPDx there.

db_csv.ask: Database CSV the analysis recipe logs its results to (blank if none)
db_csv.help: Analyze > Database Setup > Create New CSV, with the step-height result (ASH) and the sample id selected and logging enabled; the package reads the row for each scan.

port.ask: TCP port of the control server

recipes_dir.ask: Folder holding the Vision64 recipes an agent may run

max_duration_s.ask: Longest scan duration an agent may request (seconds)
